title: Check: Similar Shapes: Area and Volume (B)

questions.stem: Two similar cylinders have volumes of $24\text{ cm}^3$ and $192\text{ cm}^3$. What is the ratio of their surface areas?
questions.explanation: The volume ratio is $\frac{192}{24} = 8$, so the length scale factor is $\sqrt[3]{8} = 2$. The surface area ratio is $2^2 = 4$, giving a ratio of $1 : 4$.
